units.source_text: 良平穿越竹林的时候，洒满日金山的晚霞已经逐渐消散。

en.t: By the time Ryohei passed through the bamboo grove, the sunset that had filled Higane Mountain was already gradually fading away.

units.source_text: 良平心里越来焦躁不安。

en.t: Ryohei grew more and more anxious and uneasy.

units.source_text: 可能是因为去的时候和回的时候情况不一样，风景的差异也令让他心里很不安。

en.t: Perhaps because things were different on the way there and the way back, the change in scenery also made him feel very uneasy.

units.source_text: 这个时候，良平感觉到衣服已经被汗水都湿透了，

en.t: At that moment, Ryohei felt that his clothes were already soaked through with sweat,

units.source_text: 可是自己还必须要和刚才一样继续拼命赶路，

en.t: but he still had to keep hurrying along desperately, just as before,

units.source_text: 于是他干脆把上衣也脱下来扔在路边了。

en.t: so he simply took off his jacket too and threw it by the side of the road.
